case_name: Babita Devi vs The State Of Jharkhand

parties.petitioner_plaintiff: Babita Devi, wife of late Binod Kumar Singh
parties.respondent_defendant: The State of Jharkhand, Director General-cum-Inspector General of Police, Superintendent of Police, Deputy Inspector General of Police, Accountant General (E&O), and Anushka Kumari (minor)

facts_of_case: Appellant Babita Devi is aggrieved by the order dated 11th November 2019 passed in WP(S) No.2838 of 2019. The dispute arose between the appellant and Nutan Kachhap, with whom her husband had solemnized a second marriage.

legal_principles.principle: Children of a void marriage are legitimate.
legal_principles.held: Under Section 16 of this Act, children of void marriage are legitimate.
use_in: family pension and death-cum-retirement gratuity cases

legal_principles.principle: When there are two claimants to the pensionary benefits of a deceased employee, the State Government has to hold an inquiry as to the rightful claimant.
legal_principles.held: Disbursement of pension cannot wait till a civil court pronounces upon the respective rights of the parties.
use_in: family pension and death-cum-retirement gratuity cases

legal_principles.principle: The decision of the State Government in an inquiry cannot be a sham affair or arbitrary.
legal_principles.held: Decision has to be taken in a bona fide, reasonable, and rational manner.
use_in: family pension and death-cum-retirement gratuity cases

outcome.final_order: The writ Court approved the decision to pay pension and death-cum-retiral benefits to the appellant and Ms. Anushka Kumari.
